name: 80922 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80922 (Colorado Spgs) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80922 (Colorado Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80922 (Colorado Spgs) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
